Body: VideoMeetingHopRequest record {TenantId int, AppointmentId long, Title string, StartAtUtc DateTime, DurationMinutes int, Timezone string, Attendees List<AttendeeDto>}. (5) 200 Results.Json(MeetingResult). Outer catch NpgsqlException → 503 INV-INT-143 {error:'provider_resolve_db_outage'} + SystemError log. Outer catch OperationCanceledException → propagate (shutdown).
